why: handleRefund asserts ev.Payload.(*Refund) without the two-value form, which would panic on any other payload. Dispatch in internal/events/dispatch.go calls handleRefund only for Type == "refund", and Decode in internal/events/decode.go is the only place an Event is built: it picks the payload type from the same Type through payloadTypes, so a refund event always carries *Refund.
